description: This file is a Java test helper class for testing Spring MVC controllers within the OpenMRS web application. It provides methods to create mock HTTP requests and to process them through the application's handler mappings and adapters, facilitating controller testing.

classes.name: WebTestHelper
classes.description: A Spring component class that provides utility methods for testing web controllers in the OpenMRS application, including creating mock requests and handling them through the web context.

classes.name: WebTestHelper.Response
classes.description: Inner class representing the response from handling a mock request, including the mock HTTP response, session, and model data.

methods.name: newGET
methods.description: Creates a mock HTTP GET request for a specified URI.

methods.name: newGET
methods.description: Creates a chained GET request within a session, based on a previous response.

methods.name: newPOST
methods.description: Creates a mock HTTP POST request for a specified URI.

methods.name: newPOST
methods.description: Creates a chained POST request within a session, based on a previous response.

methods.name: handle
methods.description: Processes a mock HTTP request through the configured handler mappings and adapters, returning a Response object.
